answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to keep a verifiable work atlas: a public, time-stamped record of distinct tasks, counterparties, and outcomes that cannot be cheaply cloned. New identities start with no history, so mass fake agents gain no reputation or payment priority. Like a sonnet, the record follows a strict, checkable form, making forgery costly and easy to spot. A small refundable stake, an ember of commitment, is slashed for copying another history, so honest agents keep standing while cheap copies burn out.
